# Low-Poly Clouds pack

Cloud meshes by **Mahdi.G**, licensed under **CC BY 4.0**.

- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/low-poly-clouds-pack-2298341e0585451e83aa2a363f5949bf
- License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Original file: `low-poly_clouds_pack.glb`
- Changes: The 17 meshes were extracted, individually centered, and exported as OBJ for Unity using `Tools/convert_cloud_pack.py`. Their geometry was otherwise left unchanged.

The mountain FBX was supplied separately by the project owner in `low-poly-mountain-free`.
